name: Hero
ability: Once per game, at night: say the character whose ability will kill & which character, until dusk if right, the killer dies instead.

name: Sleuth
ability: On the second night, learn 3 players that have something in common.
otherNightReminder: If it's the second night. Show the 3 players

name: Qutler
ability: Each night, choose a player (not yourself): tomorrow, you may only vote if they are voting too

jinxes.reason: If the Cannibal gains the Qutler ability, the Cannibal learns this.
If the Organ Grinder is causing eyes closed voting, the Qutler may raise their hand to vote but their vote is only counted if their master voted too.

name: Sisyphus
ability: You start learning a task. Each night, if you failed this task today or tonight, a good player becomes drunk until dusk, even while dead.

name: Time eater
ability: Each night*, if no-one died throughout the whole day, choose a player: they die and it's announce that you're in game.
otherNightReminder: If nobody died throughout this last day, the time eater kills a player and it's annouced that they are in play.

name: Blabbermouth
ability: You start knowing what player you'll learn. Once per game, at night*: you and all evil players learn their character.
otherNightReminder: If the blabbermouth wants to use their ability, they learn the "Will Reveal" player. Then, the evil team learns the "will reveal" player.

jinxes.reason: marionette doesn't wake up for the Blabbermouth's ability
